assertion.value: This study used Generative AI tools to produce draft text, and revise wording throughout the production of the manuscript. Multiple versions of ChatGPT over different time periods were used, with all versions using the underlying GPT-4 Large Language Model. The authors reviewed, edited, and take responsibility for all outputs of the tools used in this study.
